name: Hidden
effect: While out of sight from all foes and they do not know where you are, rolls against you have disadvantage.
clears: An adversary moves where they would see you, you move into line of sight, or you make an attack.

name: Restrained
effect: You cannot move, but you can still take actions from your current position.
clears: A temporary source is cleared with a fitting action roll, a stated feature requirement, or the source ends.

name: Vulnerable
effect: You are in a difficult position in the fiction; all rolls targeting you have advantage.
clears: A temporary source is cleared with a fitting action roll, a stated feature requirement, or the source ends.
